ns2:course.label: WSI Swim Instructor Training
ns2:course.description: (KINES 169) Designed to prepare aquatic professionals to teach progressive levels of swimming. Students will also learn how to analyze human movement in the aquatic environment. May lead to American Red Cross certification both Lifeguard Training and Lifeguard Instructor Training. Prior to enrolling in this course, student must have American Red Cross Level VI swimming ability and Emergency Water Safety knowledge and ability.
